summary: Promotion could not be executed: the CLI has no promote command, the implementation lives in an OMP tool excluded from the build whose dependency is absent from package.json, and .chromarelay/project was never created. Separately, nothing in the Run was approvable — all 9 artifacts and 3 decisions carry status proposed.

claims.claim: The CLI exposes no promote command; grep -n promote src/cli.ts returns no matches.
.omp/tools/chromarelay-state.ts does not compile standalone: @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent is not in package.json and tsconfig excludes .omp/**/*.ts.
.chromarelay/project/ was never created by start or advance, and promote requires the destination to be inside it.
All 9 artifacts and all 3 decisions in this Run carry status 'proposed'; no phase, gate or command transitions a record to approved.
A decision with scope project, status approved, approvedBy equal to its own author and empty evidence was accepted by the CLI and written verbatim to decisions/.
The provenance chain itself is complete: 12 handoffs, 21 events, and sourceRefs on every artifact.

risks: The terminal phase of the flagship workflow is reachable in state but not executable through the interface that ran the other thirteen phases.
unresolved: promotion is not executable outside OMP
no mechanism exists to approve an artifact or decision
